context.transcript:
Attention passengers, welcome aboard Trilson Airways Flight 209 with non-stop service to Seattle.
At this time, please make sure your bags and personal items are properly stowed in the overhead bins or under the seat ahead of you.
Our flight today will be about six hours long and we expect an on-time arrival.
We'll be taking off in just a few minutes, so I'd like to remind you that wireless internet access is available on this flight.
You can refer to the brochure in your seat back pocket for pricing options.
Once our cruising altitude has been reached, flight attendants will come around with our complimentary beverage service.
context.transcript_translation:
乘客们请注意，欢迎乘坐 Trilson Airways 209 航班，飞往西雅图的直飞航班。
目前，请确保您的行李和个人物品已妥善存放在头顶储物柜或您前方的座位下方。
我们今天的航班大约持续六个小时，预计能准时到达。
我们将在几分钟内起飞，我想提醒大家本航班提供无线网络接入服务。
您可以参考座背口袋里的宣传册了解定价选项。
一旦达到巡航高度，空乘人员将为大家提供免费的饮品服务。
